dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Will Lady Kuutar like these statues... Ah, may the moonlight shine upon your path ahead! Are you here to pray to Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the fragments you mentioned before...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you interested in those?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... One of them should have fallen into the <color=#00E1FFFF>camp below</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the fragments you mentioned before...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you interested in those?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... One of them should have fallen on the <color=#00E1FFFF>hill to the south</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the fragments you mentioned before...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you interested in those?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... One of them should have fallen on the <color=#00E1FFFF>shore to the southwest</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the fragments you mentioned before...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you interested in those?

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... One of them should have fallen on <color=#00E1FFFF>Thunderclap Reef to the west</color>... I don't recommend you go there — it's a very dangerous place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this statue...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hehe, beautiful, isn't it? This "Idol of the New Moon" was reportedly carved by a Moonchanter from five hundred years ago, depicting Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's original form.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: As for Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar's birth and the miracles she performed in this sublunary sphere... I am but a humble acolyte, so I shall refrain from going into too many details.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: In any case, this is the final destination of the pilgrimage route where wishes are offered to Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar. Even if you didn't come here to pray, I hope you can feel her blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those small statues...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Winters in Nod-Krai are cold and long, and there is often little to do. During this time, people will take what materials they have and carve statues of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, or of the relics and legends that surround her...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Over time, this practice has become a tradition. Each statue is a symbol of its carver's desires — some wish for peace, others fertility...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: And some... Well, some people just think they look good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: May Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar bless your travels in this sublunary sphere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About this statue...

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Hehe, beautiful, isn't it? This "Idol of the New Moon" was reportedly carved by a Moonchanter from five hundred years ago, depicting the Lady Moon Goddess's original form.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: Not long ago, Lady Lauma furnished the statue with a pair of wings... May the Moon Goddess be able to spread them freely and fly where her heart desires.

dialogues.speaker: Eveliina
dialogues.text: In any case, this is the final destination of the pilgrimage route where wishes are offered to the moonlight. Even if you didn't come here to pray, I hope you can feel the moon's blessings.
